name: Front Load Washing Machine
definition: A household automatic washer that cleans textiles in a horizontal-axis drum accessed through a front door, using model-controlled water, detergent, motion, heating where fitted, rinsing and spin extraction.
excludedScope: Washer-dryers when drying performance is the purchasing subject
Commercial laundry equipment and unverified cross-model parts
primaryApplications: High-spin water extraction before separate drying
headline: Front-load washer drums, drive systems, cycles and buyer checks
description: This profile separates capacity, drum and drive architecture, water heating, dosing, spin extraction, installation and service parts so buyers can compare exact front-load washer models without treating family labels as compatibility evidence.
metaDescription: Front-load washing machine guide covering drum, drive, capacity, spin, models, standards, installation and component checks.
disclaimer: This independent category reference is not electrical, plumbing, textile-care or installation advice. Confirm the exact regional model, manual, supply, drain, floor, detergent, load, cycle, stacking kit and service-part numbers before procurement or use.

heroImageCaption: Official Bosch laundry-room image showing a front-load washer format; the paired dryer, stacking options and installation clearances remain exact-model checks.

keyFacts.label: Category boundary
keyFacts.value: Automatic household horizontal-axis drum washer with front access
keyFacts.evidence: IEC and manufacturer materials distinguish clothes-washer performance and front-load product configurations.
keyFacts.scope: Household automatic front-load washers; combination drying is excluded.

keyFacts.label: Buyer verification
keyFacts.value: Match capacity, supply, inlet, drain, stacking and service parts to the exact regional model
keyFacts.evidence: Official model pages and manuals publish materially different dimensions, utilities and configurations.
keyFacts.scope: Exact model, market and installation site.

systemFlow.name: Supply and control
systemFlow.componentFamily: Mains input, inlet valves, controller, sensors and user interface
systemFlow.role: Admits water and controls the programmed wash sequence.
systemFlow.evidence: Official manuals document model-specific supply, valves, controls and cycle logic.
systemFlow.scope: Exact voltage, water supply and regional model.

systemFlow.name: Wash and extraction
systemFlow.componentFamily: Detergent path, heater where fitted, drum, motor, suspension, pump and filter
systemFlow.role: Wets and agitates textiles, then drains and spins to remove water.
systemFlow.evidence: Manufacturer specifications identify model-specific drum, drive, dosing and spin systems.
systemFlow.scope: Declared programs, load and textile instructions.

systemFlow.name: Containment and drainage
systemFlow.componentFamily: Door lock, bellows, tub, drain pump, hose and service filter
systemFlow.role: Contains wash liquid and transfers it to the approved drain.
systemFlow.evidence: Official installation and service materials define door and drainage procedures.

variants.name: Compact front-load washer
variants.operatorRelationship: User loads through the front door and selects a programmed cycle
variants.spaceConstraints: Narrow cabinet, door swing, supply, drain and stacking clearance
variants.limitations: Nominal width does not establish usable capacity or stack compatibility.
variants.evidence: Bosch and Miele publish compact or space-conscious front-load formats.

variants.name: Full-size front-load washer
variants.taskScale: Routine family laundry and larger source-declared loads
variants.operatorRelationship: User sorts, doses and selects a textile-appropriate cycle
variants.spaceConstraints: Cabinet depth, open-door depth, service access and floor loading
variants.limitations: Capacity labels are not comparable without the market test method.
variants.evidence: LG, Samsung, Whirlpool, Electrolux and Haier publish full-size configurations.
variants.scope: Exact regional model and rating method.

performanceMetrics.name: Rated capacity
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Source-declared textile load under a named test or market convention
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: kg and cu ft labels can use different methods and cannot be directly ranked
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Do not convert a volume label into a textile mass claim.
performanceMetrics.evidence: Official regional pages publish capacity in market-specific units.
performanceMetrics.scope: Exact model and declared test basis.

performanceMetrics.name: Spin speed and extraction
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Mechanical water extraction before line or machine drying
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Maximum rpm varies by cycle, load balance and textile protection
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Higher rpm alone does not prove lower residual moisture or better care.
performanceMetrics.evidence: Manufacturers publish model-specific maximum spin settings and cycle qualifications.

performanceMetrics.name: Water and energy use
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Utility demand under a defined regulatory or manufacturer program
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Cycle, temperature, load, test method and market differ
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Annual or cycle values are not comparable across unlike methods.
performanceMetrics.evidence: IEC 60456 defines performance testing while regional product records publish model values.

applicationFit.wcbAssessment: Run witnessed loads that represent actual textiles, soil and detergent practice.
applicationFit.assessment: Run witnessed loads that represent actual textiles, soil and detergent practice.
applicationFit.basis: Load mix, cycle, water, chemistry, spin and user behavior interact.
applicationFit.limitations: A capacity or cycle label does not guarantee the site result.
applicationFit.buyerAction: Record load mass, cycle time, residue, tangling, extraction and post-cycle care.
applicationFit.evidence: Official sources publish model-specific cycles and load guidance.

applicationFit.wcbAssessment: Verify the complete installation drawing and accessory codes before ordering.
applicationFit.assessment: Verify the complete installation drawing and accessory codes before ordering.
applicationFit.basis: Door swing, hoses, ventilation, service access and stacking hardware define fit.
applicationFit.limitations: Visual alignment or shared brand does not prove stack compatibility.
applicationFit.buyerAction: Attach measured opening, supply, drain and exact stacking-kit number to the quote.
applicationFit.evidence: Manufacturer documentation provides model-specific dimensions and accessories.
applicationFit.scope: Actual site and exact washer-dryer pairing.

componentStack.name: Water, dosing and heating system
componentStack.role: Admits, meters and conditions wash liquid.
componentStack.evidence: Official pages document different inlet, heating and dosing configurations.
componentStack.scope: Exact model and market; no cross-model fit.

componentStack.name: Drum, drive and suspension
componentStack.role: Turns the load through wash action and high-speed extraction.
componentStack.evidence: Manufacturer specifications show different drive and drum systems.

componentStack.name: Door, drain and service system
componentStack.role: Locks and seals the opening, then removes wash liquid.
componentStack.evidence: Official manuals define model-specific door and drain service.

representativeModels.evidence: Bosch publishes the exact model and specifications.
LG publishes the named model and specifications.
Samsung publishes the named model and features.
Whirlpool publishes the exact model and installation data.
Miele publishes the named washer and feature set.
Haier publishes the exact model and stated data.

procurementDecisions.attributeToVerify: Usable capacity, cycle result, extraction and care
procurementDecisions.comparisonTrap: Ranking by drum volume, kg label or maximum spin alone
procurementDecisions.assessment: Use matched witnessed loads and record the complete cycle.
procurementDecisions.basis: Ratings, programs, balance control and textiles differ.
procurementDecisions.limitations: No single catalogue number predicts the result.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Compare like-for-like loads under documented settings.
procurementDecisions.evidence: IEC and official model sources expose differing rating boundaries.

procurementDecisions.attributeToVerify: Utilities, stacking, pump, seal, filter and electronics support
procurementDecisions.comparisonTrap: Assuming same family name or dimensions establish part fit
procurementDecisions.assessment: Price the exact installed configuration and service parts.
procurementDecisions.basis: Regional assemblies and accessory codes differ.
procurementDecisions.limitations: Future part availability is not guaranteed.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Obtain exact accessory and five-year service-part numbers in writing.
procurementDecisions.evidence: Manufacturers publish model-specific installation and support records.

engineeringChecks.reason: Incorrect supply, pressure, hose routing or floor support can create safety and performance risks.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Use the exact installation manual and qualified local installation where required.
engineeringChecks.evidence: IEC safety scope and manufacturer instructions define appliance and site requirements.
engineeringChecks.scope: Exact regional product and local rules.

engineeringChecks.reason: A front door and bellows create model-specific cleaning, drainage and ventilation needs.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Inspect the seal and filter and follow exact post-cycle maintenance instructions.
engineeringChecks.evidence: Manufacturer support materials define cleaning and service access.
engineeringChecks.scope: Exact model; no hygiene outcome is inferred.

standards.name: IEC 60456:2010
standards.applicability: Methods for measuring performance of household clothes washing machines.
standards.evidence: IEC publishes the standard scope and edition.
standards.scope: Confirm regional adoption and the exact declared test method.

standards.name: IEC 60335-2-7:2024
standards.applicability: Particular safety requirements for household washing machines.
standards.evidence: IEC publishes the standard scope and current edition.
standards.scope: Confirm regional conformity for the exact product.

developments.title: Current front-load platforms expand automated dosing and cycle controls
developments.summary: Reviewed current official ranges combine horizontal-axis washing with model-specific dosing, sensing, app or rapid-cycle functions.
developments.evidence: Official current product pages document these functions without establishing cross-model equivalence.
developments.scope: Named products available at verification time.
